about_the_game:
🚪 The Elevator | Beyond The Doors – DEMO

This is a playable demo for The Elevator | Beyond The Doors, a psychological visual novel about memory, regret, and the choices that define us.

In this demo, you'll experience the first two floors of the elevator—a deeply personal journey through family memories and a past relationship. Each choice you make subtly alters the dialogue, emotional tone, and future possibilities.

🌒 What’s Included in the Demo:

✔ Two Fully Playable Floors (Out of five in the full game)
✔ Two Emotional Choice Points shaping the narrative tone
✔ Unique Visual Novel Mechanics: No generic menus—only emotion-driven story flow
✔ Hand-Drawn Black & White Aesthetic for a dreamlike atmosphere
✔ Original Sound Design evoking introspection and mystery
✔ Approx. 30-40 minutes of gameplay depending on your reading speed and choices

💭 What Awaits in This Demo?

  • 1st Floor: Revisit your childhood and understand the hidden emotions behind your family’s silence.

  • 2nd Floor: Reconnect with a love that slipped away—and question whether it was truly lost.

Every floor is a confrontation with the past.
Every choice opens a different emotional path.

🧠 Who Should Play This Demo?

🎮 Players who enjoy atmospheric, choice-driven visual novels
🎮 Fans of introspective narratives about memory, love, and self-doubt
🎮 Those curious about the psychological tone and structure of the full game
🎮 Anyone wondering, “Can I still change the path I’m on?”

Will you face your past, or keep hiding behind the doors?
This demo invites you to take the first steps.
The rest... is up to you.

🔜 About the Full Game:

The full version will include all five floors, deeper branching choices, ten different endings, and a complete emotional arc. If this demo resonates with you, consider wishlisting the full game to follow its release.

short_description: A narrative-driven psychological visual novel where every floor of an elevator reveals a key moment from your past. Face your regrets, uncover forgotten memories, and make choices that shape your future. Will you find closure, or remain trapped in your own mind?
